{{Top|leg}}
'''Beacon 784432''' was located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], known at that [[Time/Legends|time]] as Imperial Center, around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The beacon, which helped lead unfortunate individuals directly to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and later to [[Ysanne Isard]], was located in [[Tower 78]], level 443, landing bay 2. The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Objurium]]'' used Beacon 784432 to guide [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to Palpatine immediately after the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star's]] [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|explosion]] and [[Kirtan Loor]] to see Isard to later explain the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Gil Bastra]].
